title: the Faster, Patriarch of Constantinople
name: Mamas
John
kontakia: (Tone 3) O holy Mammas, with the staff God gave to you,* lead your people as a flock to life-giving pastures;* crush the invisible and fierce enemies beneath the feet of those who honour you;* for all those in danger have received you as their fervent intercessor.

(Tone 3) You proved yourself a heavenly vessel of abstinence, O blessed John,* and a lasting treasure of piety.* Your life was radiant with perfect self-control,* and you enriched the poor with alms, O Father John.* Beg Christ to have mercy on all of us.
